div.div:
AuditArchiveService
1. build ArchivedRecord: topic, partition, offset, key, eventType, payload, timestamp
2. skip if the idempotency key is already in the window
3. sink.write(archived)
4. only then mark it seen

AuditEventDecoder · classifies, never produces the archived bytes
A generic Avro reader, not a specific one, so this module needs no compile-time dependency on every schema in the platform.
A null value returns Tombstone, legitimate on the compacted topic.

div.div:
DefaultErrorHandler
Three attempts total, 100ms doubling to a 5s cap.
AuditDecodeException is not retryable: the bytes do not improve.
setRetryListeners gives the DLQ event a real retryCount.
setAckAfterHandle(true): one poison payload never blocks the partition.

div.div:
DeadLetterPublisher · platform-common
Topic derived as record.topic() + ".dlq", never configured per service.
Keeps the original key, so a replay preserves per-key order.
The recoverer joins on the send, so a failed quarantine stops the container.

div.div:
AuditSink
LoggingAuditSink today: logs the record and discards it.
S3 Parquet, the sidecar manifest, the KMS signature and Object Lock retention are Phase 3, so no evidence claim rests on this yet.

div.div:
Why 3 comes before 4
Marking the key seen before the sink accepted the record makes a failed write look like a completed one to the retry that follows. The record is then dropped rather than quarantined: a silent hole in the evidence trail, with nothing failing anywhere.

div.div:
The idempotency key · topic-partition-offset
An access-ordered LinkedHashMap bounded at 100000.
Covers redelivery inside a running consumer. Does not survive a restart: that belongs to the durable sink, whose object key carries the offset range.

div.div:
{topic}.dlq
DeadLetterEvent, 30 days, source-aligned partitions.
Quarantine is per record. There is no event-type-wide breaker: one would stop archiving every healthy record behind the poison one.
